A '''sturdy leather gambeson''' is the [[Sturdy leather armor|sturdy leather]] [[Armor#Chestplate|chestplate]], crafted from [[Sturdy Leather|sturdy leather]]. It gives 5 armor and has 350 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/sturdy_leather_chestplate.json}}</ref>

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===

Worn, it gives 5 armor.

It adds 2 blocks of safe fall distance.

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Projectile Protection]] IV

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Sturdy leather armor]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Tattered Leather|tattered leather]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

== History ==

{{History line|1.10|Armor raised from 4 to 5, equal to the golden chestplate.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Safe fall distance raised from 1 to 2 per piece, and the armor can be repaired with tattered leather.}}
}}
